items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I worked with Billy Moran. Well they were going to the Excelsior Band, Billy Moran.

ctx.x: How'd it come back? You met his brother, Wilfred? His son. Oh no, I introduced Wilfred to you or somebody out there. No, not me. Wilfred Doyard was out there. Who I introduced him? To Ralph. Yeah, one of them, they were so sad. He lived down there, we can go there sometime whenever you want, or Two Road Street. I know where he lived. Yeah. What about Billy Moran? Billy Moran. Did you ever work with him?
